title: Distant Neighbors 2
description:
Custom Global-Constraint:
1a. Each 3x3 Box starts with a value of zero. Each Box's marked cell: defines the Box's identity
- e.g: If the marked cell in any Box is a digit=6, then that Box is identified as [Box 6].
1b. Any two Boxes sharing a Border= cannot be identified as consecutive digits.

2. There cannot be consecutive digits orthogonally next to a marked cell(s).

3. Any  two 3x3 Boxes sharing a border= a three edge cells next to the neighboring box, must not contain consecutive digits relative to the neighboring Box’s identity.
- E.g: If identified [Box 4] is next to identified [Box 6]= then a three edge cells in [B6] that touch the [B4], can never contain the digits 345; and a three edge cells in [B4] that touch the [B6], can never contain the digits 567.
